entries.name: box-apply-coll-sigmaprop-root-accept#0

entries.name: box-context-datainputs-root-reject#2
entries.description: A bare box whose unsized tree is 00 db 65 01 fe: PropertyCall(SContext.dataInputs) on CONTEXT, a Coll[Box] root.
